issue.title: Enhancement:make test_bgp_stress_link_flap more robust in sonic-vpp

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

bgp/test_bgp_stress_link_flap.py failed occasionally but more consistent recently due to memory check failure:
failed on teardown with "Failed: [ALARM]: docker:swss, Current memory usage 8.1% exceeds high threshold 8% (previous: 6.6%, current: 8.1%)"
This is due to vpp dataplane takes longer to handle route update trigger from link flap. In the current test case, there is a 60 seconds sleep before proceeding to teardown, which is when memory usage check happens. Because vpp takes longer to handle the route changes, after 60 seconds, it is still not finished yet. So the system has not returned to the original state (more routes than before). This causes memory check failure.

### Current Behavior

sleeps 60 seconds

### Proposed Behavior

Adds more sleep time for vpp
